optimizedDescription.value: Detect VCS staleness and derivation mismatches, enforce warn-not-block read policy, lock index runs, and manage configuration fallbacks.

optimizedContext.value:
# Staleness Detection

## Rules

- Storage & comparison: persist `lastIndexedRef` in metadata. Compare `lastIndexedRef` with `VcsAdapter.ref()`. If unequal -> `stale: true`; equal -> `stale: false`; `lastIndexedRef === null` -> `stale: null` (unknown, not stale).
- Derivation fingerprint: `@specd/code-graph` version + canonical hash of resolved workspaces in `specd.yaml`. Mismatch between stored and current fingerprint sets `fingerprintMismatch: true`.
- Policy:
  - Warn-not-block: read commands (`graph stats`, `graph search`, `graph impact`, `graph hotspots`) warn when stale/mismatched but return results.
  - Repair: `graph index` repairs fingerprint mismatch via `recreate()` full rebuild or fails requiring force re-index.
- Output:
  - Text: `⚠ Graph is stale (indexed at <7-char-ref>, current: <7-char-ref>)` or `⚠ Derivation fingerprint mismatch...`.
  - JSON/TOON: `stale: boolean|null`, `currentRef: string|null`, `fingerprintMismatch: boolean|null`.
- Centralized lock: filesystem lock inside config directory (`.specd/config/graph/index.lock`). Managed via `assertGraphIndexUnlocked`, acquire, release.
- Health orchestration: `GetGraphHealth` is canonical entry point for health diagnostics.
- Config fallback & merging: merge global/workspace `allowedPaths`/`excludePaths`/`respectGitignore` into `ProjectGraphConfig`. Generate synthetic fallback `SpecdConfig` when `specd.yaml` absent.
- Freshness latches & observations: persist `knownStaleSinceLastIndex` latches per workspace/aggregate; cleared only on successful index. Aggregate precedence: `stale > unknown > current`.

## Constraints

- VCS-agnostic via `VcsAdapter` from `@specd/core`.
- Ref stored as opaque string; staleness check does NOT trigger auto-reindexing.
- Lock control, config merging, and staleness calculations encapsulated in `@specd/code-graph` / `@specd/core`, not CLI helpers.
